description: This file defines a Kivy application class 'SettingsApp' that provides a GUI for selecting and displaying different settings panels and display types, including popups and sidebar options.

classes.name: SettingsApp
classes.description: A Kivy application class that manages different settings panels and display modes, providing a GUI with buttons and labels to configure and display settings.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the main layout with buttons and labels for user interaction.

methods.name: on_settings_cls
methods.description: Handles changes to the settings class, currently destroys existing settings.

methods.name: set_settings_cls
methods.description: Sets the class of the settings panel to be used.

methods.name: set_display_type
methods.description: Sets the display mode ('normal' or 'popup') and destroys existing settings.

methods.name: display_settings
methods.description: Displays the settings panel either as a popup or within the app, depending on the display type.

methods.name: close_settings
methods.description: Closes the settings popup if open.
